name: Process hazard analysis (HAZOP, LOPA, QRA)
principle: HAZOP is a structured team examination of a design that applies guide words to process parameters to find deviations, causes, consequences and safeguards. Probabilistic risk assessment adds quantified likelihood and consequence.

process_steps.name: Divide design into nodes on P&IDs
Apply guide words (no, more, less, as well as, part of, reverse, other than)
List causes, consequences and safeguards; set actions
